description: Comparison of AMD2 targeting features with characterized amidase-signature enzymes of known subcellular location
code:
import requests, re, time, json
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

panel = [
 ("AMD2 (S. cerevisiae)","P22580","unknown (query)"),
 ("HER2/GatA (S. cerevisiae)","Q03557","mitochondrion (UniProt, cleaved transit peptide)"),
 ("FAAH1 (rat)","P97612","ER membrane, N-term TM anchor"),
 ("FAAH2 (human)","Q6GMR7","membrane / lipid droplet"),
 ("AmdS acetamidase (A. nidulans)","P08158","cytosol (characterised)"),
 ("Malonamidase E2 (Bradyrhizobium)","Q9ZEU2","bacterial cytoplasm (crystal structure)"),
 ("AMI1 (A. thaliana)","Q9LQB7","plant, IAM hydrolase"),
]
kd = dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,
          K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
eis = dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
           L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
STRICT=re.compile(r"[SAC][KRH][LM]$"); PERM=re.compile(r"[SAPCTNKQGV][KRHNQSM][LMIVFYA]$")
PTS2=re.compile(r"[RK][LVIQ]..[LVIHQ][LSGAK].[HQ][LAF]")
def mom(s,deg=100):
    a=np.deg2rad(deg)*np.arange(len(s)); h=np.array([eis[x] for x in s])
    return np.hypot((h*np.cos(a)).sum(),(h*np.sin(a)).sum())/len(s)

rows=[]
for label,acc,known in panel:
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60)
    if r.status_code!=200: print("miss",acc); continue
    jj=r.json(); s=jj["sequence"]["value"]
    feats=[(f["type"],f["location"]["start"]["value"],f["location"]["end"]["value"]) for f in jj.get("features",[])
           if f["type"] in ("Transit peptide","Signal","Transmembrane","Intramembrane")]
    loc=""
    for c in jj.get("comments",[]):
        if c.get("commentType")=="SUBCELLULAR LOCATION":
            loc="; ".join(x.get("location",{}).get("value","") for x in c.get("subcellularLocations",[]))
    h=np.array([kd[a] if a in kd else 0 for a in s])
    kd19=np.convolve(h,np.ones(19)/19,mode="valid")
    n30=s[:30]
    rows.append(dict(protein=label, acc=acc, len=len(s), known_location=known,
        uniprot_SL=loc or "none annotated",
        uniprot_targeting_features="; ".join(f"{t}:{a}-{b}" for t,a,b in feats) or "none",
        cterm3=s[-3:], PTS1_strict=bool(STRICT.search(s[-3:])), PTS1_perm=bool(PERM.search(s[-3:])),
        PTS2_nonapeptide_N60=bool(PTS2.search(s[:60])),
        nterm30_RK=sum(a in "KR" for a in n30), nterm30_R=n30.count("R"),
        nterm30_DE=sum(a in "DE" for a in n30),
        first_acidic_pos=next((i+1 for i,a in enumerate(s) if a in "DE"), None),
        max_helix_moment_N42=round(max(mom(s[i:i+18]) for i in range(0,25)),3),
        max_KD19_N40=round(float(kd19[:40].max()),2),
        max_KD19_all=round(float(kd19.max()),2),
        n_TMwindows_KD19gt1_6=int((kd19>1.6).sum())))
    time.sleep(0.25)

D=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",400); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",46)
print(D[["protein","len","known_location","uniprot_SL","uniprot_targeting_features"]].to_string(index=False))
print()
print(D[["protein","cterm3","PTS1_strict","PTS1_perm","PTS2_nonapeptide_N60","nterm30_R","nterm30_DE",
         "first_acidic_pos","max_helix_moment_N42","max_KD19_N40","max_KD19_all","n_TMwindows_KD19gt1_6"]].to_string(index=False))
D.to_csv("amidase_family_targeting_comparison.csv",index=False)

# figure: N-terminal hydropathy profiles
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
cols=plt.cm.tab10(np.linspace(0,1,10))
for i,(label,acc,known) in enumerate(panel):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    s="".join(r.splitlines()[1:])
    h=np.array([kd.get(a,0) for a in s]); k=np.convolve(h,np.ones(19)/19,mode="valid")
    lw=3 if acc=="P22580" else 1.4
    ax[0].plot(np.arange(1,min(81,len(k)+1)), k[:80], lw=lw, color=cols[i%10], label=label.split(" (")[0])
    n30=s[:30]
    ax[1].bar(i, sum(a in "KR" for a in n30)-sum(a in "DE" for a in n30), color=cols[i%10])
ax[0].axhline(1.6,ls=":",c="k"); ax[0].text(55,1.68,"TM / signal-peptide threshold",fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlabel("window start residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (19-aa window)")
ax[0].set_title("N-terminal hydropathy of amidase-signature proteins"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=7.5,frameon=False)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(panel))); ax[1].set_xticklabels([p[0].split(" (")[0] for p in panel],rotation=35,ha="right",fontsize=8)
ax[1].axhline(0,c="k",lw=.8); ax[1].set_ylabel("net charge of residues 1-30 (K+R minus D+E)")
ax[1].set_title("N-terminal net charge\n(mitochondrial presequences are strongly positive)")
for a in ax: [a.spines[s].set_visible(False) for s in ("top","right")]
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
